$comment: One entry per exhibit (README.md). class: where the bug lives. fixedBy: the pull request that fixes it, or open. fixRef: the git ref built for the 'with fix' column. requires: install axes this repository lacks (rntl 12/13, vitest 4, layout pnpm). bugSignature: a regex for the bug's own failure line (anchored to the exhibit's file); consequences: lines the bug causes without identifying itself (lost files, exit codes), accepted only beside a signature line; judged by validation/config-axes/verdict.mjs (lib/verdict.mjs). bugPreventsEveryFile: the bug rejects the configuration before any file runs. buggyRef: a build that has the bug (a fix PR's regression, or the pre-fix state of a bug main cannot reach). preFixRef: the build before a landed fix. status: written by status.mjs from run-columns.mjs verdicts, each checked against the SHA columns.json records for its column.
